component.name: keyvo
component.summary: Nine tiles that follow your context

description.p: keyvo turns the Logitech MX Creative Keypad into a context-aware, scriptable control surface for developers on Linux. Profiles switch with the focused window, and the nine LCD keys show the actions that matter right now.
This app is the editor and mirror of the keyvo daemon, which runs on the host and drives the device:

ul.li: See the pad's tiles live and press a key from the screen
Edit a key's label, icon and action, and the pad follows
Pick actions from a catalogue of recipes
Open a profile's TOML file in your editor

description.p: The app needs the keyvo daemon running on the host; it talks to it over the daemon's local socket and edits the profiles in ~/.config/keyvo.
The first beta build: the desktop app and the keyvo CLI as a Flatpak.
